back_translation: Roam through the streets of Jerusalem; look now and take note; search her squares. See whether you can find a single person who does justice and seeks faithfulness, and then I will forgive her.
Even though they say, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' they are still swearing falsely.

O LORD, do not Your eyes look for faithfulness? You struck them, but they felt no pain; You destroyed them utterly, but they refused to accept discipline. They made their faces harder than rock and refused to repent.
Then I thought, 'These are only the poor; they act foolishly, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.'
I will go to the great ones and speak with them, for surely they know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God. But they too had all alike broken the yoke and torn off the chains.

Therefore a lion from the forest will seize them, a wolf from the desert will ravage them, a leopard will lie in wait near their cities; everyone who goes out from them will be torn to pieces, because their rebellions are many and their apostasies have multiplied.
How can I forgive you? Your children have forsaken Me and sworn by what are not gods. I satisfied them, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.
They are like well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing after his neighbor's wife.
Shall I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD. And shall My soul not avenge itself on a nation such as this?
Go up through her vineyard rows and destroy them, but do not make a full end; strip away her branches, for they do not belong to the LORD.
For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have utterly betrayed Me, declares the LORD.
They have lied about the LORD and said, 'He will do nothing; no disaster will come upon us; we will not see sword or famine.'
And the prophets are but wind; the word is not in them at all. Let what they say happen to themselves.
Therefore the LORD God of Hosts says this: 'Because you have spoken this word, behold, I will make My words in your mouth a fire, and this people the wood, and that fire will consume them.'

O house of Israel, behold, I am bringing against you a nation from afar, declares the LORD — a strong and enduring nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know and whose speech you do not understand.
Their quiver is like an open grave; they are all mighty warriors.

They will eat your harvest and your food; they will eat your sons and daughters; they will eat your flocks and herds; they will eat your vines and fig trees; with the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.
Yet even in those days, declares the LORD, I will not make a full end of you.

And when they ask, 'Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?' you are to say to them, 'Just as you forsook Me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve foreigners in a land that is not yours.'
Declare this in the house of Jacob, and proclaim it in Judah, saying:
Hear this, O foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear.

Do you not fear Me? declares the LORD. Do you not tremble before Me, who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an everlasting decree it cannot cross? Though the waves surge they cannot prevail; though they roar they cannot cross it.
But this people has a stubborn and rebellious heart; they have turned aside and gone away.
They have not said in their hearts, 'Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives the rain — the early rain and the latter rain in its season — and who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.'
Your iniquities have pushed these things away, and your sins have withheld the good from you.
For among My people are found wicked men; they crouch in wait like fowlers; they set a trap to catch men.
Like a cage full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit; therefore they have become great and rich.
They are fat and sleek; they also overflow in evil deeds. They do not judge the cause of the fatherless, so that the orphan might prosper, nor do they defend the rights of the needy.
Shall I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD. And shall My soul not avenge itself on a nation such as this?
An astonishing and horrifying thing has happened in the land:
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority, and My people love it so. But what will you do in the end?
